spans.s: वट् (I) vt. 1P (pres. वटति) To surround, to envelop.
वट् (II) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. वंटति, वंटयति-ते) To divide, to partition, to apportion.
वट् (III) vt. 10U (pres. वटयति-ते) 1. To surround, to envelop; 2. to divide, to separate.
वट (I) m. 1. The Indian fig tree, सोयं वटः श्याम
इति प्रतीतः
R.xiii.53; 2. a cowrie; 3. a small ball; 4. a kind of cake; 5. a cipher; 6. equality in shape; 7. a string, a rope.
वट (II) n. A string, a rope.
वाट m.n. 1. An enclosure, a piece of enclosed ground, विचितश्चैष श्मशानवाटः M.M.v.; 2. a garden, a park; 3. a road; 4. the groin; 5. a sort of grain.
वट-पत्र m. a kind of white basil.
वट-पत्रा f. a kind of jasmine.
वट-वासिन् m. a Yaksha.
वटक m. 1. A kind of cake; 2. a small ball, a globule.
वटर m. 1. A cock; 2. a thief; 3. a mat; 4. a turban; 5. a churning-stick.
वटाकर m. A cord, a string.
वटाकर m. A cord, a string.
वटिक m. A pawn at chess.
वटिका f. 1. A pill; 2. a chessman.
वाटिका f. 1. The site of a house; 2. a garden, अये दक्षिणेन वृक्षवाटिकामालाप इव श्रूयते Sak.i.
वटिन् m. The same as वटिक q.v.
वटी f. 1. A rope, a string; 2. a pill.
वाटी f. 1. The site of a house; 2. a house, a dwelling; 3. an enclosure; 4. a garden, a park; 5. a road; 6. the groin.
वटु m. 1. A boy, a lad, निवार्यतामालि किमप्ययं वटुः पुनर्विवक्षुः स्फुरितोत्तराधरः K.S.v.83; 2. a Brahmachārin (q.v.)
वटुक m. 1. A boy, a lad; 2. a fool, a blockhead; 3. a Brahmachārin (q.v.).
वाट-धान m. the descendant of an outcast Brāhmaṇa by a Brāhmaṇa female, M.x.21.
वाट्या f. Name of a plant.
वाट्याल m. Name of a plant.
वाट्या f. Name of a plant.
